programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Deadly Threat : A suspected drug dealer would stop at nothing to keep local and federal authorities from building a case against him. When his organization started targeting the government itself, federal agencies went on high alert.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Sniper At Home : In Georgia, a series of bizarre shootings terrorized a small town. Two people were killed. Two others were critically wounded. At first, the shootings seemed targeted. Then they seemed random.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Dangerous Cause : In the late 70s and early 80s, a legitimate Puerto Rican independence movement took hold in the United States. But a splinter terrorist group known as the FALN was suspected of executing hundreds of bombings in major US cities.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Operation Goldenrod : In the 1980s, the United States faced a deadly new enemy abroad, an expanding network of terrorists targeting American interests. Hundreds of innocent people were killed in bombings, executions, and hijackings.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Terror For Sale : In the 1980s the drug trade ravaged Chicago's inner city neighborhoods. Heroin and cocaine sales soared. Violent crime threatened to destroy the community.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Temple of Fear : In Miami, the discovery of a mutilated body sent investigators on the trail of a deadly cult. But agents found a wall of silence around the cult's members. Potential witnesses, terrified of reprisals, refused to talk.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Dark Woods : While camping with her family in Montana, a seven-year-old girl was abducted from her tent. No one in the campground witnessed the crime and the kidnapper left no clues.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Deadly Paradise : It should have been Shangri-La, but when bad blood developed, piracy took over and the only law was the law of the jungle.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Driven to Kill : A serial rapist targeted women. His dark urges raged out of control and led him to murder. He followed a path so random it was impossible to trace, and all that tied him to his crimes were his access to the highways and a bizarre sexual fetish.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Crime Spree : They swept through six states like a plague, thrill killers acting without rhyme or reason. They targeted adults and young girls, kidnapping, and murdering. And in their rampage, they left plenty of clues, but moving targets are the hardest to hit.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Killing Spree : In 1984, in South Florida, a rapist and murderer was on the loose. The killer was a ruthless and terrifying predator, the newest member of an infamous group known as serial killers.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Death In The Delta : When a wealthy young woman was abducted in front of her in-laws' home, the police had no shortage of suspects. The 25-year-old victim left behind a tumultuous marriage, an ex-husband and old boyfriends. All were on the FBI's short list.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Deadly Takeover : Two armed bank robbers hit a Seattle bank taking over 150,000 dollars. Before they can escape police confront them and the pair splits up. As authorities search block by block they learn one was a career criminal with a long history of violence.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Firefight : In Miami, a gang of robbers targeted banks and armored cars. They carried assault weapons and weren't afraid to use them. They struck during the day, and sometimes twice a day. For awhile, they seemed unstoppable.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Cracking The Cartel : A mother and child are kidnapped a bystander is murdered. Violence such as this shattered a quiet Texas neighborhood and exposed a drug cartel that flourished where it was least expected.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Dishonored : Shirley Russell was determined enough to reach the rank of Captain in the United States Marine Corps. When this officer turned up missing, her colleagues refused to believe she had gone AWOL. It was unclear whether Captain Shirley Russell was alive.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Coroner's Casebook : A good coroner provides what's necessary to solve a crime. A bad one can spoil an otherwise rock-solid case. Cyril Wecht and Henry Lee, two of the country's most respected coroners, share their cases and insights into crime solving.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Fatal Compulsion : Forensic psychologists delve into the minds of serial killers, explaining why, most often, they can be a friendly neighbor or the tenacious co-worker  the one who hides his or her dark side better than anyone else.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Dead Men Do Talk : Profiles the work of world-renowned forensic experts and the procedures they use to solve murders and other mysteries in minutes or centuries after they happen.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: A Taste of Poison : Poisoners are the most devious of killers, relying on stealth or their victim's trust in order to steal their lives. They're the most dangerous creatures in the world: smart assassins. And they usually don't stop at one kill.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Mind Hunters : Psychological Profiling: Journey into the dark recesses and calculated madness present only in our worst nightmares and in the minds of serial killers.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Deadly Target : Ballistics: A corpse is found with a gunshot wound to the head; the weapon lies next to the victim. It looks like suicide, but could it be murder? It's a question best solved by ballistics experts.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Cold Cases : These cases took a decade or more to solve. There's no statute of limitations on murder. As a case turns cold, the clues become scarce, investigators must rely on science to close cold cases.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Natural Witness : The Great Outdoors may offer great clues to solving brutal murders. But it takes the keen eye of the forensic entomologist and botanist to decipher the clues nature provides.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Stolen Identity : When a theft is committed, something valuable is stolen. But when a criminal needs a new identity, theft becomes a matter of life and death.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: A Taste of Poison : Poisoners are the most devious of killers, relying on stealth or their victim's trust in order to steal their lives. They're the most dangerous creatures in the world: smart assassins. And they usually don't stop at one kill.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Betrayed : Sometimes when a death seems to be accidental or the result of a tragic accident, it is up to forensic scientists to reveal the deception lying just below the surface.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Trial Of The Century : Forensics in the O.J. Simpson Murder Trial: Millions watched on television as the jury rendered their verdict. Orenthal James Simpson was found not guilty of murder.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Lethal Dosage : Toxicology: While drugs can cure disease and ease pain, they can also be agents of murder. Toxicologists can examine blood and tissue to uncover cases where death is not as natural as it may seemfrom slow arsenic poisoning to quick cocaine overdoses.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Shreds of Evidence : Hairs and Fibers: The tiniest filament can become a mark of distinction in the most singular and intimate of ways. Investigators have come to rely on forensic evidence as fine as a carpet fiber or as innocent as an eyelash to crack difficult cases.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Invisible Death : Poison is an almost invisible form of death, and toxicologists must look for hidden clues in blood and tissue to bring these murders to light.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Murder By Numbers : For serial killers, once is never enough. For investigators, the challenge is steep when the killers murder by numbers.

programme.desc: Mailbox's Birthday : It's our friend Mailbox's birthday and we need to figure out what his favorite birthday game is.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: Blue's Story Time : It's story time and Blue wants to read her favorite story so we play Blue's Clues to figure out what the story is.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: What Does Blue Need? : As we discover what Blue needs, we take the time to help Mr. Salt and Mrs. Pepper find fruits by describing where they are in relation to each other.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: Blue's Favorite Song : It's song time but first, Blue and Steve listen to sounds and figure out the musical instrument, remember the line of a song, and see which chick is singing in tune.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: Adventures in Art : Blue and Steve are ready to begin painting. We play Blue's Clues to figure out what else Blue wants to paint in her picture.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: Blue Goes to the Beach : Steve and Blue are going to the beach! In this episode, we decide what clothes they should wear, experiment with physics, and help sea creatures find their way back.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: What Does Blue Wanna Do on a Rainy Day? : As it starts to rain, Steve and Blue discover that the raindrops sound like music. Blue decides she would like to do something musical, so we play Blue's Clues to figure out what Blue wants to do on this rainy day.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: Blue's Surprise at Two O'Clock : Blue has a surprise for us, but it won't be ready until 2 o'clock. Using our watch, we time activities and discover the difference between seconds and minutes while we wait for our surprise.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: The Lost Episode! : We play Blue's Clues to figure out where Blue was when she lost her backpack. Guided by a hand saying -- Go back, go back, go back to where you were!

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: Blue's Sad Day : Something is making Blue sad, so we play Blue's Clues to figure out what it is. Along the way, we talk about feelings and figure out how to resolve difficult situations and emotions.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: What Game Does Blue Want to Learn? : We play Blue's Clues to figure out what game Blue wants to learn. In the meantime we solve number problems, practice learning our lefts from our rights, and jump into the felt board to play tic-tac-toe with O-Friend.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: What Did Blue See? : It's Blue's Clues from a whole new perspective! We play Blue's Clues to figure out what Blue saw. Along the way, we see things through mirrors and kaleidoscopes, from up above and down below.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: Nurture! : We help Steve and Blue take care of their plants, and now there's something else that we need to do. We play Blue's Clues to figure out what it is.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: Blue is Frustrated : Something is frustrating Blue, so we play Blue's Clues to figure out what it is. We learn to "stop, take a deep breath, and think" when we find ourselves in frustrating situations.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: What Is Blue Trying To Do? : Blue wants to show us something she's been trying to do, so we play Blue's Clues to figure out what it is.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: Mechanics! : We help Steve and Blue fix their broken toy plane. There's something else to fix, so we play Blue's Clues to figure out what it is.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: Art Appreciation : We are having a big art show and we play Blue's Clues to figure out what Blue is making for the show.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: Weight and Balance : We play Blue's Clues to figure out what Blue wants to do. Throughout the day, with the help of our scale friends, we compare the weight of objects and determine which are heavy and which are light.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: Geography : We play Blue's Clues to figure out where Blue wants to go. Using a map, we help Shovel and Pail figure out which buildings would be best suited for specific errands then we decide what form of transportation would work best.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: What's that Sound? : Blue hears something that we can't hear, so we play Blue's Clues to figure out what it is. Led by our ears, we help Shovel and Pail follow the path a gopher took in the woods, based on the sounds he makes.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: Signs : Guided by signs and symbols around the house, we play Blue's Clues to figure out where Blue wants to have her snack.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: Hide and Seek : Steve and Blue are playing Hide and Seek and it's Blue's turn to hide. We play Blue's Clues to figure out where Blue wants to hide.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: Animal Behavior : We play Blue's Clues to figure out what animal Blue wants to learn about. Throughout the episode, we learn about different animal behaviors by observing them and pretending to be them.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Les riches debarquent : Se sentant rejeté, Token décide d'appeler d'autres riches. Mais les hommes de la ville ne supportent pas l'arrivée de ces riches.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Kenny Se Meurt : Cartman tente de sauver la vie de Kenny en suppliant le Congrès de faire reprendre la recherche sur les cellules souches.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: L'Episode de Butters : Butters fait quelques découvertes qui vont changer le cours de son existence. Son père est bisexuel et sa mère tente de le tuer. Heureusement tout s'arrange à la fin.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Couillo-mentonite : Le Maury Povich Show reçoit des personnes difformes et leur offre des cadeaux. Les gamins décident d'envoyer Butters au show avec des testicules en latex attachées au menton.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Asspen : Vacances à Aspen. Les gamins ont des ennuis avec des ados fous de ski et les parents vont vivre l'enfer de l'arnaque.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: La bande-annonce du nouveau Terrance et Phillip : Le visionnage d'une bande annonce se transforme en course contre la montre pour trouver une télé valable.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Le veau, c'est rigolo : Les enfants se soucient du sort des veaux qui sont en réalité des bébé vaches torturés.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Professeur Chaos : Butters est exclu du groupe des gamins. Excedé, il s'invente un alter-égo maléfique, le Professeur Chaos. Pendant ce temps, Stan, Cartman et Kyle mettent en place une sélection pour trouver un remplaçant à Kenny.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Les cathos, c'est chaud : Le père Maxi propose aux enfants de partir pour une croisière en compagnie de prêtres et d'évêques venus de tous les pays. Mais Randy raconte qu'il a entendu aux informations que les prêtres faisaient subir des mauvais traitements aux enfants.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Bérets Gratos : Les gamins en ont marre que les scénaristes retouchent leurs films avec des images de synthèse ou en éditant les images ou les mots choquants.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Les seins de Bebe mettent en danger la société : La puberté fait irruption à South Park: Barbara a des seins qui poussent et les garçons ont un comportement des plus bizarres.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Les enlèvements d'enfants, c'est pas marrant : Les parents sont victimes de la psychose de l'enlèvement. Au fil des infos, ils apprennent que leurs enfants peuvent être enlevés par eux-mêmes.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Une échelle pour aller au ciel : Pour profiter d'une razzia de bonbons, les gamins sont contraints de retrouver Kenny au ciel pour récuperer un ticket de la plus haute importance.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Le retour de la communauté de l'anneau des deux tours : Une nuit de folie, où les gamins passionnés par Le Seigneur des anneaux vont entretenir un quiproquo terrible à propos d'un film pornographique substitué à une copie du Seigneur.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Les Jefferson : Une nouvelle famille arrive à South Park : les Jefferson. Monsieur Jefferson accueille les enfants de South Park chez lui pour les faire jouer dans son parc personnel.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Poire à lavement et sandwich au caca : La SPA manifeste contre l'utilisation d'une vache comme mascotte de l'école élémentaire de South Park. Les écoliers sont obligés d'en choisir une autre.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Le Supermarché des Ténèbres : La rue principale de South Park se transforme en ville fantôme quand un supermarché géant Wall Mart attire les citadins jusqu'à son tout nouveau magasin aux affaires incroyables.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Maternelle : Cela fait cinq ans que Trent Boyett est en prison. Celui-ci y est incarcéré, à la place des garçons, pour avoir brûlé leur professeur de maternelle. Quand il sort de prison, les enfants paniquent alors à l'idée de sa vengeance.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Course à l'audience : Les garçons de South Park produisent leur propre journal d'informations du matin sur la station de télévision de l'école, et sont immédiatement entraînés dans une intense course à l'audience.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Kit vidéo pour stupide pute trop gâtée : Paris Hilton ouvre une boutique en ville, dans laquelle toutes les petites filles pourront acheter de quoi se transformer en parfaite peste. Son chien s'étant suicidé, Paris veut acheter Butters pour le remplacer.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Le don incroyable de Cartman : Après avoir reçu une sévère blessure à la tête, Cartman se voit doté de dons de voyance.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Le Noël des petits animaux de la forêt : Stan est sollicité par un groupe d'adorables animaux de la forêt pour les aider à construire une crèche pour la naissance de leur Seigneur et sauveur. Il accepte, mais découvre qu'ils servent en fait Satan.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Le Vagin tout neuf de M. Garrison : Monsieur Garrison subit une opération de changement de sexe, mais il se rend compte qu'il ne pourra jamais connaître les plaisirs d'avoir ses règles ou l'avortement.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Crève hippie, crève : La ville de South Park est envahie par les hippies qui veulent faire un festival. Leur ennemi juré, Cartman, compte bien les arrêter.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Wing : Stan, Kyle, Cartman et Kenny décident de devenir imprésarios. Après l'échec de leur travail avec Token, on leur confie Wing, la femme du gérant de City Wok.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Potes pour la vie : Kenny obtient une PSP, mais il meurt. En réalité, Dieu l'a choisi pour mener une lutte salutaire au paradis. Malheureusement, les docteurs réaniment Kenny, qui se retrouve dans un état végétatif.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: La fureur de perdre : Les enfants de South Park sont désespérés : leurs parents veulent absolument qu'ils jouent au baseball mais eux s'ennuient terriblement. Tout empire lorsqu'ils apprennent qu'un match de qualification les obligerait à jouer tout l'été.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: La Mort d'Eric Cartman : Les enfants se mettent d'accord pour ignorer Cartman, et ce dernier croit qu'il est mort. Butters, qui n'est pas au courant de la supercherie, devient le médium de Cartman.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Le jour des érections : Jimmy a des problèmes d'érections impromptues. Étant donné qu'il doit participer au concours de talents, il cherche de l'aide pour résoudre ce problème.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Marjorine : Butters maquille sa mort pour que les garçons puissent récupérer un appareil à faire des prédictions.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Suivez cet œuf : Madame Garrison a encore des sentiments pour Monsieur Esclave, mais en allant le voir elle s'aperçoit qu'il est avec Al Super Gay et qu'ils comptent se marier.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Les Rouquins : Cartman fait un exposé raciste sur les roux. Pour lui donner une leçon, Stan, Kyle et Kenny le teignent en roux dans son sommeil. Mais Cartman s'adapte à la situation en créant une ligue qui clame la supériorité des roux.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Piégé dans le placard : Stan est endoctriné par l'Église de Scientologie avant de découvrir qu'il ne s'agit que d'une vaste machination.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Background Blues/And Now Let's Talk To Some Kids : Wouldn't it be cool to find out that your ancestors were famous frontier explorers? But what if they were just...plain folks? The Magic Toolbox show is coming to Ratburn's class to put the kids on TV!

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: The Chips Are Down/Revenge Of The Chip : What a mysterious, beautiful thing a green potato chip is--and D.W. just ate a gigantic one! But then she hears a rumor that they're poisonous...Sure, kids do some pretty embarrassing things, but do Moms have to tell everyone?

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Binky Rules/Meet Binky : Writing your own name in graffiti all over the school wouldn't be very smart, right? Binky says he didn't do it, so detectives Fern and Buster are on the case. Then, Binky is the newest, hottest, hippest pop music craze in Elwood City.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Arthur Rides The Bandwagon/Dad's Dessert Dilemma : Woogles have their own names and personalities and they're so darned cute! programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Popular Girls/Buster's Growing Grudge : Sue Ellen and Fern take a popularity quiz in a magazine and change their personalities to become more likable, but it backfires. And Buster's convinced that his great joke will be the difference between a successful oral report and failure.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Arthur's Treasure Hunt/The Return Of The King : When Buster digs up an ancient arrowhead, everyone else wants to hunt for buried treasures, too. And a field trip to the Medieval Fair pits Arthur's class against another led by Ratburn's super-tough mentor, Mr. Pryce-Jones.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Attack Of The Turbo Tibbles/D.W. Tricks The Tooth Fairy : If you think the Tibbles are bad now, imagine what they'd be like if they had super powers! Then, D.W. needs money, quick. When she tries to pull a fast one on the Tooth Fairy, will Arthur have to pay?

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Double Tibble Trouble/Arthur's Almost Live Not Real Music Festival : Playing with the Tibble twins requires preparation, endurance and earplugs. But when one gets sick, playing with the other should be a lot easier, right? Arthur and the gang create their own music videos.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: What Scared Sue Ellen?/Clarissa Is Cracked : Sue Ellen's not afraid of much, but when she encounters a really creepy howling noise in the woods, she's scared for real. Then, Grandma Thora has a lot of fun stuff, especially her porcelain doll, Clarissa.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Arthur's Dummy Disaster/Francine and The Feline : When painfully shy George brings a ventriloquist dummy to school, a popular kid is born! Then, Arthur thinks the best pet to have is a dog, and Francine probably would have agreed--that is, until little Nemo, a cute kitten, came along.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Mom and Dad Have A Great Big Fight/D.W.'s Perfect Wish : When Mom and Dad fight over spilled milk, Arthur and D.W. fear the worst. Is it Arthur's fault or D.W.'s? Then, turning five is a major, big deal event! But D.W. worries that she fribbled away her preschool years on meaningless pursuits.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Arthur and D.W. Clean Up/The Long, Dull Winter : Arthur just might make it to Happy Crazy Wow Day at the park--if he and D.W. can work together to clean their rooms! Then, Arthur and the gang realize they are suffering from the January doldrums brought on by an acute lack of holidays.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Prunella's Special Edition/The Secret Life Of Dogs & Babies : The latest book about everyone's favorite boy wizard--Henry Skreever--is finally out! programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Muffy's Soccer Shocker/Brother, Can You Spare A Clarinet? : Muffy's proud that her dad is the new soccer coach--until he exhausts the team with demanding drills. programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: The Boy Who Cried Comet/Arthur and Los Vecinos : Buster is convinced that he's seen real UFO's, and he uses Muffy's fancy new telescope to get the proof. Then, Mr. Sipple from next door is moving away and Arthur wonders--who will be the new neighbors?

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Citizen Frensky/D.W.'S Backpack Mishap : After visiting The Elwood City Times, Francine decides to start her own paper--The Frensky Star! The tabloid is a success--until all her friends stop speaking to her. Somebody stole D.W.'s backpack!! Who is this fluffy unicorn thief?

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: The Boy With His Head In The Clouds/More! : All the kids know that George is smart--so why does he sometimes have trouble reading and writing? Then, D.W. is thrilled to be getting an allowance. At last, she'll be rich and powerful!

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Rhyme For Your Life/For Whom The Bell Tolls : While struggling to write a poem for his mom, Binky falls asleep and gets trapped in Verseberg--where it's a crime not to rhyme! And D.W. has lost her voice! For Arthur it's a dream come true--until Mom asks Arthur to take care of D.W.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: The Good Sport/Crushed : When the Athlete of the Year Award doesn't go to Francine, she makes no effort to hide her hurt feelings from the recipient. Arthur can't believe his parents are hiring a babysitter--he's 8 years old, and babysitters are b-o-r-i-n-g!

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Arthur Loses His Marbles/Friday The 13th : When Arthur discovers that Grandma Thora is a marbles champion, he trains with her so he can beat all his friends. Then, Brain doesn't believe in superstitions, so when he has a string of bad luck, he's stunned.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Cast Away/The Great Sock Mystery : Arthur is thrilled when Dad invites him to go fly-fishing for the weekend. But a change in plans forces them to include D.W. Find out once and for all where socks disappear to when Baby Kate and Pal team up to solve the great sock mystery.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Francine's Split Decision/Muffy Goes Metropolitan : Lakewood Elementary is sure to win the big bowling tournament on Saturday, but Francine's cousin is having his Bar Mitzvah at the same time! Muffy happily accepts an invitation to spend the weekend in the bustling Crown City.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Ants in Arthur's Pants/Don't Ask Muffy : To excel in science, the class has to prove that they have P.A.N.T.S.--the ability to be patient, attentive, nosy, thoughtful, and systematic. And Muffy starts an advice column to launch her career as a rich and famous talk-show host.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: To Tibble the Truth/Waiting to Go : When the Tibble Twins' constant lying lands them in constant trouble, they promise to tell only the truth. Binky and Brain collide on the soccer field, breaking Brain's new watch and nearly breaking their friendship.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Elwood City Turns 100! : Arthur and his friends commemorate their 100th episode in style! Mr. Ratburn's class is chosen to stage a musical tribute to Elwood City for its centennial celebration, which quickly becomes a drama behind the curtain!

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Pick a Car, Any Car/Jenna's Bedtime Blues : The family car is broken, and so is Arthur's heart. How can Mom and Dad even think of replacing it? It’s Muffy's annual slumber party, and Jenna is finally invited! But what if the other girls discover that she's an occasional bed-wetter?

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: D.W.'s Time Trouble/Buster's Amish Mismatch : D.W. is tired of being bossed around all the time and demands to know why she couldn't have been born before Arthur! And during a trip to Amish country, Buster becomes enamored with the simple life and vows to forgo modern conveniences.

programme.desc: Matthew Mounce : Rob, Steelo, and Chanel laugh till it hurts at Unnecessary Combos, people who should Stay out of the water, and others who just plain wonder Who Put That There? Karate expert Matthew Mounce helps break down some Bad Karate.

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: Jeff Tremaine : Producer Jeff Tremaine joins Rob in breaking down what it means to Lawnchair and Slam and Sprint. Some kids start slamming young in Ridiculousness in Training, and Rob points out Your Friend's a Dick.

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: Matt Schlager : Beauty Queen Caite Upton joins Steelo on the panel. Rob breaks down the magic of Man-kinis and Dodging Bullets. Guest Matt Schlager demonstrates how to fall with your face first and hands second, in Getting Schlagered.

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: Chris "Drama" Pfaff : Rob's cousin Drama helps Rob break down Family Dysfunction, Your Friend's a Dick, and Little Rollers. Credit Cards compete for pain against Popsicles. And learn whether Parkour is an art or just some Aggressive Running.

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: Judd Leffew : Bull rider Judd Leffew schools Chanel on whether bulls get dizzy when Rob breaks down A Bunch of Bull and Angry Animals. Watch fools compete in the Ridiculousness Decathlon. And a whole lot of people get Dunked.

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: Biker Fox : Caite Upton joins Steelo once again as Rob shows off S**t Whips and Redneck Good Times. A lot of people blow out their money-makers in De-Faced. Biker Fox joins the panel for some fun in spandex and scrapes in Biker Down.

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: Ryan Dunn : TV star Ryan Dunn joins the fun as Rob points out the problems with Lower Education. See some folks who are clearly Out of Your League while others get slammed in That's What You Get and Let Me Help You Hurt Yourself.

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: Dan Heaton : Rob breaks down Why Rollerblading Should Make a Comeback. Witness a merry-go-round of pain in Worst Case Scenario, Almost Made It and Not Even Close. And guest unicyclist Dan Heaton shows off some Uni-Psychos.

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: Cole Hernandez : Learn How Not to Treadmill and why Grass is Your Friend. See a wake of damage after Trees Strike Back. Guest dancer Cole Hernandez brings some Weird Dancing. Some skaters get Racked. Rob narrates Chicken Police.

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: The Dingo II : The Dingo is back! Laugh as a whole lot of people have a Tough Day on the Job, find out if You're Too Old For That, and who's Almost Awesome. Rob breaks down Skiers vs. Snowboarders. Shoes go flying off in Shoe Down.

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: Big Black II : Big Black is back and he's showing off Black Lavender. See what happens When Bad Ideas Go Worse and people suffer a Failure to Launch. Rob's got a special category that only comes once: You Couldn't Do That Again if you Tried.

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: Justin Bieber : Justin Bieber stops by the set to show off some of his Canadian pride, learn about Humanimals and what Popcorning is really all about.

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: Floyd Mayweather : Floyd Mayweather visits the Ridiculousness studio where Rob shows him what a Pain Face looks like. They'll also endure some Romantic Injuries and learn How Not To Train.

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: Sara Jean Underwood : Former "PMOY", Sara Jean Underwood, visits the Ridiculousness set where Rob shows off his Fear Face and they talk about how Cats are Weird.

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: Quinton "Rampage" Jackson : UFC fighter & former champion, Quinton "Rampage" Jackson, shows his wolf battle cry and what really sets off his Hot Button. Rob also shows videos of Crappy Endings and what it's like to get Slampaged.

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: A$AP Rocky : Rob is joined by Rapper A$AP Rocky who demonstrates "A Sneaky Ass Play" and shows us why fine older ladies "Still Got It."

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: Ray J : Singer Ray J drops by the studio to watch some "Knockout Entertainment" and discuss the danger of "Selfies."

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: Chanel and Sterling IV : Rob, Sterling and Chanel marvel at some "Man Squirrels" and the unfortunate timing of people who become "Collateral Damage."

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: Eddie Barbanell : Actor Eddie Barbanell and Rob take a look at some adorable "Humanimals" and feel the music with a little bit of "Mancing."

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: Joanna Krupa : Rob and Super Model Joanna Krupa practice some "Partial Arts" and sneak a peak at some "Man Juggies."

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: Chanel and Sterling V : Rob, Sterling and Chanel enjoy some "Dirty Getaways" and some unskilled workers proving why this has to be their "Last Day on the Job."

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: Steve Aoki : Rob and International DJ Steve Aoki practice some "Instant Yoga" and check out the crowd madness at music "Mess-tivals"

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: Cody Simpson : Rob Dyrdek and Australian singer superstar Cody Simpson witness some extremely "Awkward Dates" and discover the internet's most "Anti-Viral Sensations."

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: Fantasy Factory : Drama, Big Black and The Fantasy Factory crew stop by the studio to make some "Miracle Shots" and get "Gassed Up!"

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: Nick Swardson : On an all-new episode of Ridiculousness, comedian Nick Swardson shows Rob what it means to be "Old and Horny," the lifestyle of "Day Drunks," and how he knows: "My Car's a Dick."

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: Snoop Dogg a.k.a. Snoop Lion : On an all-new episode of Ridiculousness, entertainment icon Snoop Dogg/Snoop Lion and Rob enjoy some "Over the Tizzle Celebrizzles," watch the "Foreign 5-0" bumble their jobs and see what happens when kids have "Too Much Pep."

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: Sterling and Chanel VI : On an all-new episode of Ridiculousness, Rob, Sterling and Chanel are in the studio "Freaking Out" over the new epidemic "Heavy Leg Syndrome" and they discover the fine art of "Extreme Sitting."

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: Jamie Lee : On an all-new episode of Ridiculousness, comedian Jamie Lee teaches Rob all about "Girl Code," discusses the merits of "Drunk Sluts" and learns she's not the only one who's "Bad with Kids."

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: Stevie Ryan : On an all-new episode of Ridiculousness, actress Stevie Ryan introduces Rob to "Jamie-Lynns," learns "Jelly Limbs" are an international problem, and discusses the ins and outs of "Getting Dookied."

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: Chanel and Sterling VII : On an all-new episode of Ridiculousness, Rob, Sterling and Chanel cross the pond to learn more about "British Dads" and "Wet Dumps" and share the new sport of "Free Biking."

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: Mike Epps : On an all-new episode of Ridiculousness, actor and comedian Mike Epps and Rob watch people "Getting Zombied," stuffing food in unlikely places to "Save it for Later" and ponder who is most deserving of "Bond or Burial" money.

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: Jenna Marbles : On an all-new episode of Ridiculousness, Internet sensation Jenna Marbles and Rob breakdown the web's best "Face Lookers," people whose injuries are "Selfie Inflicted" and the recent "Nerf-pocalypse."

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: Michael B Jordan : On an all-new episode of Ridiculousness, actor Michael B. Jordan tells Rob about the pitfalls of Bad Bro-mates, learns some new Crying Styles and scores some Human Field Goals.

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: Lil Duval : On an all-new episode of Ridiculousness, comedian Lil Duval stops by the studio; Rob warns of the dangers of "Evil Tires" and how having a "Florida Vibe" isn't always a good thing.

programme.title: Modern Marvels

programme.title: Modern Marvels

programme.title: Modern Marvels

programme.title: Modern Marvels

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: Chicken Poofs/Stupid Cupid : Chicken Poofs/Stupid Cupid: Poof gets the "Chicken Poofs" and turns everyone into actual chickens! Timmy steals Cupid's arrows in an attempt to make Trixie fall in love with him and go to the school "Romance Dance."

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: Double Oh Schnozmo/Planet Poof : Double Oh Schnozmo/Planet Poof: Cosmo’s brother, the top secret spy, pays a visit. But when Schnozmo’s revealed to be nothing but a con man, Wanda demands that Schnozmo participate in a real spy adventure in order to spare Cosmo’s feelings.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: The Boss of Me/He Poofs, He Scores! : It's "Bring Your Kid to Work Day," and Dad takes Timmy to his office. When Timmy accidentally eats Poof (who is hiding as a marshmallow in Timmy's cereal) Timmy becomes magically talented at soccer.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: Play Date...of Doom/Teacher's Pet : Play Date... of Doom/Teacher's Pet: Foop is back! He’s escaped from prison and convinced Cosmo and Wanda he’s ready for a playdate with Poof. But he’s really there to try and destroy his arch enemy again, and it’s up to Timmy and Poof to thwart his plan.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: Manic Mom-Day/Crocker of Gold : When Timmy gripes that being Mom is easier than being a kid, Wanda takes the bait and switches their brains. Now Mom is Timmy, and Timmy is Mom!

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: Poltergeeks/Beach Blanket Bozo : When Mom and Dad mistake Cosmo for a ghost and restart their failed ghost-hunting business, Timmy wishes that the fairies would pretend to haunt Dimmsdale.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: Old Man and the C-/Balance of Flour : After failing miserably on a game show for 6th graders, Dad admits he dropped out of school in the 5th grade. The next thing Timmy knows, Dad’s in his class!

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: Food Fight/Please Don't Feed the Turners : Food Fight/Please Don't Feed the Turners: Tired of Mom’s terrible dinners, Timmy wishes Mom were the best chef in the world.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: Take and Fake/Cosmo Rules : Timmy borrows Mark Chang’s Fake-i-fier in order to attend Trixie’s costume party. Unfortunately, he knows nothing about Yugopotamian technology and soon the device is causing Timmy to turn into all sorts of crazy creatures.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: Lights Out/Dad Overboard : An exhausted Timmy makes a wish for complete darkness so he can get some sleep. But he doesn’t count on Cosmo and Wanda turning into Scary Fairies in the dark.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: Farm Pit/Crock Talk : Dad decides to convert the Turner home into a farm. Unfortunately, it takes Cosmo and Wanda’s magic to give Dad a green thumb, and when they’re swept away by a tornado, it’s up to Timmy to save the farm...and his fairies!

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: Operation Dinkleberg/Spellementary School : Dad changes Timmy’s room into a surveillance center to prove that his kindly neighbor, Dinkleberg, is truly evil. Being the best neighbor ever, Dinkleberg pretends to be evil just to make Dad feel better.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: Love Triangle : Poof and Foop compete to win the affections of Goldie Goldenglow, a magical new girl at Spellementary School (who’s shaped like a triangle) while participating in the Spellementary School play, "Mr. Cookie’s Happy Day."

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: Stage Fright/Gone Flushin' : Stage Fright/Gone Flushin': Vicky decides to be an actress and makes Timmy help her land her first role. Dad accidentally flushes Timmy and the fairies down the toilet.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: Fairly Old Parent : Fairly Old Parent: Poof finally becomes a fairy godparent. Unfortunately, it’s to Mrs. Crocker.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: School of Crock : School of Crock: Poof is going through "pooferty" and is finally learning to speak! Meanwhile, Mr. Crocker becomes a teacher at the Fairy Academy and tries to steal all the students’ magic!

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: Dimmsdale Tales : Dimmsdale Tales: Dad takes the Squirrely Scouts on a camping trip and forgets all the supplies. Timmy tries to make the most of their trip by telling a collection of scary stories around a campfire.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: The Past and the Furious : The Past and the Furious: Cosmo and Wanda take Timmy on a trip back in time to meet some of their past Godkids. But things take a turn for the worst when Timmy interacts with the past and alters the future!

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: The Fairy Beginning : The Fairy Beginning: When Jorgen discovers that Cosmo never graduated from the Fairy Academy, he threatens to take away his job as Fairy Godparent. To solve the mystery of what happened, the gang looks through Cosmo’s memories of his teenage years.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: Fairly Odd Fairy Tales : Fairly Odd Fairy Tales: In order to put a restless Poof to sleep, Wanda decides to read him a book of Fairy Tales. Only the "fairy tales" Wanda reads are the classic stories with a "Fairy Odd Parents" spin!

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: Man’s Worst Friend : Man's Worst Friend: In order to make Timmy and his family miserable, Foop replaces Sparky with the Anti-Sparky. When that plan works, Foop decides to make all of Dimmsdale unhappy by replacing everyone's pet with an evil pet.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: The Big Fairy Share Scare : The Big Fairy Share Scare: Timmy finds out that he has to share his fairies with the new girl in school, Chloe Carmichael. But when Chloe realizes she can use her magic for good, she wishes everyone in Dimmsdale would share everything, and chaos ensues.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: Whittle Me This/Mayor May Not : Whittle Me This/Mayor May Not: Catman thinks Timmy has been kidnapped. He mistakes Chloe for Catgirl and enlists her help to save Timmy. Timmy wishes Dad was Mayor, but Timmy gets tortured by the paparazzi and risks having his fairies discovered.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: Girly Squirrely/Birthday Battle: Transmorphers Versus Unicorns : Girly Squirrely/Birthday Battle: Transmorphers Versus Unicorns: Chloe joins the Squirrely Scouts and saves the troop by helping them get their first merit badge. Timmy and Chloe find out they have the same birthday and compete for the best party.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: The Fair Bears/Return of the L.O.S.E.R.S. : The Fair Bears/Return of the L.O.S.E.R.S.: Chloe’s favorite cartoon characters come to life and brainwash Timmy and Wanda. Timmy’s enemies learn that he is helpless without his fairies and try to destroy him when he’s weak.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: A Sash and a Rash/Fish Out of Water : A Sash and a Rash/Fish Out of Water: Chloe thinks she has a stress-caused rash and wishes to be a slacker, but Dimmsdale falls apart without her. Dad wants to catch a giant fish to win a trophy, but Chloe wishes all the fish could fight back.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Love Triangle : Learning your spouse is a cheater is devastating, but how do you recover when his lover is also your best friend? This young couple was newlyweds when she found him in bed with her best friend and bridesmaid. He says he loves both--can Dr. Phil help?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Our Mother Is A Manipulator Who Abandoned Us As Children : Dustin, Chance & Nova say mom Sonya, is a liar & manipulator, neglecting them--deplorable conditions, no food, no hot water. They say mom bought fast food for herself & her boyfriend as they starved. Then she disappeared. Sonya says she doesn't remember.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Big-Time Moochers : Dr. Phil’s guests say they have a moocher in their midst, but they don’t know how to kick this freeloader to the curb! Karen and Rex say they’re tired of their 24-year-old twins, Andrew and Justin, living under their roof.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The Student And The Professor: Is One Stalking The Other : Dr. Phil tries to unravel the truth in a toxic relationship between a student and a professor. Did they cross the line? Will they take responsibility for their roles in this ill-fated acquaintance?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: What The Children Remember: Was Mommy Murdered : Dr. Phil digs into a heartbreaking story of a father's search for his missing daughter, then the loss of his grandchildren taken away by the man who may be guilty of their mother's disappearance. Don't miss this chilling tale that spans three generations.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Teen Mama Drama : Dr. Phil discusses teen pregnancy: In the U.S., one in six become teen moms with fathers often not held to the same accountability in child-rearing. Taten, 18, has an infant daughter with one teen girl, with another teen pregnant. Paternity test results.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Held Hostage By My Father : Ashley was sexually abused by her father from ages of 5 to 18, locked in a small camper, while giving birth to four of her father's children. In her first national interview since her father's arrest, the 22-year-old mom speaks about her horrible ordeal.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Catfish Controversy: A Mom & Son Face Off Pt. 2 : Dr. Phil continues his conversation with Nancy, who adamantly denies her online love relationship with "Shaun" is a scam. Nancy and her son Darcy speak face-to-face for the first time in over a year. Plus updates from past catfished guests!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Honeymoon Hangover : Are you newlyweds suffering Honeymoon Hangover? The Bahamas vacation is over, the dress is put away and couples realize they now have this to face: Married Life. Dr. Phil discovers how little couples know about each other before they walk down the aisle.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Falsely Accused Mothers? : Stacy and her boyfriend are accused of burning her 3-year-old daughter with cigarettes. What will lie detector tests reveal? Plus, Christina's mother has called CPS on her four times for allegedly abusing her grandson. Are Christina's kids in danger?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Most Outrageous Monster-In-Law Returns : The Monster-In-Law is back! Khalood confessed to calling her son-in-law, Steve, a "loser" and "dumbass" and lacing his drink with a laxative! Does she still say Steve is incapable of supporting a family? Hear what Steve’s mom has to say about the feud!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Banned From The Wedding : A bride-to-be takes on her future mother-in-law in an ugly feud that has torn a family apart. Can Dr. Phil cut through the drama and broker some peace for this family?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Absentee Mom, Clueless Dad : John says his ex-wife, Laurie, abandoned their children. John admits his boys disrespect his authority, with one son punching him in the face. As Laurie denies deserting her children, we hear from the three boys: is it clueless parenting or unruly kids?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The Honeymoon's Over : Do couples give up too easily on marriage? More newlyweds, married only a few months, are pulling off their wedding bands and calling it quits. Dr. Phil's guests haven't even been married a year, and are already wondering if they made the right decision.

programme.title: Dr. Phil

programme.title: Dr. Phil

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Time Is Running Out For Prison-Bound Dad: Did His Wife Blackmail Him Into Embezzling $300,000 : An emotional intervention on Dr. Phil's stage: Siblings Sarah and PJ say for the past two years their mom, Kim, chose alcohol and pills over her four children. With father Pete headed to prison for mail fraud in a few weeks, the family is falling apart.
